name: Sound! Euphonium
description: Spring in the first year of high school. Kumiko, a member of the brass band in junior high school, visits the high school brass band club with classmates Hazuki and Sapphire. There, she comes across Reina, her former classmate from junior high. Hazuki and Sapphire decide to join the club, but Kumiko can’t make up her mind. She recollects her experience with Reina at a competition in junior high school.

videos.title: Ready, Set, Monaka
videos.overview: The 10 members of the concert band club who failed Taki's audition form "Team Monaka" to support the club members participating in the Kyoto Concert Band competition. Even as they support the performers, they continue to hone their playing, and make monaka-shaped good-luck charms to hand out to their club mates before the competition. Although they didn't play in the competition, they still had things they had to do. But on the day of the competition, the members on their way to the concert hall receive a shocking message! This is Team Monaka's hot summer story.

videos.title: Welcome to High School
videos.overview: Kumiko enters Kitauji High School having been unable to forget what Reina said at a middle school concert band competition. She goes to visit the concert band at school along with classmates Hazuki and Sapphire, where they meet Reina again.

videos.title: Nice to Meet You, Euphonium
videos.overview: Kumiko and the others join the concert band, and they choose their instruments. Their eccentric senior, Asuka, still likes to mess with them.

videos.title: The First Ensemble
videos.overview: Kitauji High School Concert Band is preparing their parts for the ensemble, but some students are fooling around when they should be practicing.

videos.title: Singing Solfège
videos.overview: Kumiko and the others prepare for Sunrise Festival. Kumiko and Shuichi talk about Taki-sensei on the way home from school, when they run into Reina.

videos.title: Festival Time
videos.overview: The concert band receives their marching band uniforms and begins marching practice in preperation for SunFes. Things are different now, with the members all more engaged in practice. And SunFes day arrives.

videos.title: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Tuba
videos.overview: Starting this year, the band holds auditions for members participating in the competition. First-year Hazuki has a chance, too. The bass section does everything they can to encourage her.

videos.title: Crybaby Saxophone
videos.overview: The band is hard at work preparing for the audition and the competition. Aoi has trouble with her part, to which Taki says, "when will you be better by?"

videos.title: Festival Triangle
videos.overview: The band is abuzz with talk about who they'll be going to the upcoming festival with. There's someone Hazuki wants to go with, but that someone is already going with someone else. Meanwhile Kumiko somehow ends up going with you-know-who.

videos.title: Please, Audition
videos.overview: The audition for the competition participants has come. Everyone must demonstrate their abilities, whether they're a third-year or a first-year. And then, the results are revealed.

videos.title: Straight Trumpet
videos.overview: The band suspects Taki played favorites in choosing Reina in the auditions. Noticing the band's rising distrust of Taki and Reina, he makes a proposal.

videos.title: Welcome Back, Audition
videos.overview: Taki-sensei's proposal relieves the upset within the band, and everyone returns to practicing. Reina no longer isolates herself either, much to Kumiko's relief. But then she sees Yuko, who's been antagonizing Reina, speaking with her.

videos.title: My Euphonium
videos.overview: The competition's coming up. Kumiko is suddenly asked to play a difficult phrase from a different part. She begins practicing, but...

videos.title: Goodbye Competition
videos.overview: The competition performance is "only" 12 minutes long. It's both a blink of an eye and an eternity. The Concert Band members bet their entire youths on this competition. And Kitauji High School Concert Band's performance begins.

videos.title: Mid-summer Fanfare
videos.overview: Having won first place at the Kyoto competition, Kumiko and the band are preparing to compete in the Kansai competition. A shadow looms over them when an old member, Nozomi Kasaki, enters the picture.

videos.title: Hesitation Flute
videos.overview: Kumiko and her buddies head to the pool for one last breath of freedom before their grueling concert band training. There, Nozomi reveals some of what had happened the year before.

videos.title: Troubled Nocturnes
videos.overview: The high school Kitauji fanfare begins its intensive summer camp before the Kansai competition. Kumiko is still trying to find out more about Asuka's refusal to reinstate Nozomi and intends to respect her promise to the girl.

videos.title: Awakening Oboe
videos.overview: Nozomi finally meets Mizore. She learns, the hard way, why Asuka had been keeping her away.

videos.title: Miraculous Harmony
videos.overview: Only three schools will be selected at the Kansai Concert Band Competition to compete in the Nationals. Will Kitauji High School be one of them?

videos.title: Rainy Conductor
videos.overview: It's the school festival at Kitauji High School. Kumiko's sister insists on quitting college, while Taki reveals some things about his past with his wife.

videos.title: Station Concert
videos.overview: Asuka's mother wants her to quit the concert band. This upsets everyone -- including her mother.

videos.title: Rhapsody in Flu
videos.overview: Asuka invites Kumiko over for a study party. With Kumiko's sister quitting college and Asuka's band membership uncertain, Kumiko and Reina are forced to contemplate the role of music in their lives.

videos.title: Sound! Euphonium
videos.overview: Asuka is about to lose her seat competing in the Nationals. But that might not be why she invited Kumiko over.

videos.title: After-school Obbligato
videos.overview: Taki's deadline for Asuka draws near. She refuses to admit that she wants, more than anyone, to compete in the Nationals.

videos.title: First Love Trumpet
videos.overview: With Asuka back in the competition, the orchestra is just about set for the Nationals. Meanwhile, Kumiko tries to understand why Reina is upset at her.

videos.title: The Last Competition
videos.overview: It's the big day: the All Japan Concert Band Competition Nationals.

videos.title: Early-Spring Epilogue
videos.overview: With the competition over and the third-years graduating, Kumiko is left to sort through her feelings: Is it a love of concert band, of the euphonium, or of something else?

videos.title: New Euphonium
videos.overview: A new year is starting at Kitauji Kyoto Prefectural High School, and that means clubs are clamoring to recruit new members. The concert band welcomes newcomers and sets their goals for the season. Will they choose to fight for gold at Nationals?

videos.title: Triangle Syncopation
videos.overview: Taki decides to let the band executives choose their competition piece this year. The leadership deliberates on this decision while trying to get the rest of the band ready to perform at the Sunrise Festival.

videos.title: Blue Prelude
videos.overview: The concert band begins taking itself very seriously to give itself the best chance possible of winning gold at Nationals. Unfortunately, the intense environment has some of the new recruits discouraged and intimidated.

videos.title: Etude with You
videos.overview: The day of the Sunrise Festival finally arrives, and it's time for the concert band to have their first performance of the year. Proximity to other schools and bands brings some of Motomu's family issues to light.

videos.title: Twilight for Two
videos.overview: Now that she's well into her third-year, Kumiko is now facing pressure from teachers and parents alike to choose what she's doing after high school. Concert band members form groups to attend the Agata Festival, but Kumiko has other plans.

videos.title: Wavering Dissonance
videos.overview: The Prefecturals are coming up and that means the first of many auditions for the members of the concert band. Mayu is still hesitant to audition despite reassurance from the others. Some of Taki's choices for the competition confuse members.

videos.title: Summer Fermata
videos.overview: Members of the concert band are given a brief, three-day summer break that quickly fills with plans of all sorts. Some of the third-years attend an event to gather information on different colleges and plan their futures.

videos.title: Melancholy Ostinato
videos.overview: The three-day summer camp has begun, and members of the concert band are faced with a rigorous training regimen. Mayu hesitates to audition yet again, afraid that she'll take the soli part from Kumiko. Motomu speaks to Midori in private.

videos.title: Dissonant Tuning
videos.overview: Mayu taking the soli part has made the concert band uneasy. Despite Kumiko's insistence that this is how it should be, several members take issue with Taki's decision.

videos.title: Expressing Arpeggios
videos.overview: The Kansai competition is right around the corner, and the band's dissent about Taki-sensei's decisions only continues to grow. Kumiko goes to speak with him, and she has to decide whether to speak her mind.

videos.title: Orchestra to the Future
videos.overview: The concert band receives its Kansai competition results. Reina and Kumiko see Yoroizuka perform with some of their senpais. However, Kumiko and Reina's relationship becomes precarious as she continues to insist she won't go to music school.

videos.title: The Last Soloist
videos.overview: Taki decides that the band will choose the euphonium soli player by voting on one final audition. Kumiko then decides that they should choose based on sound alone, and so the two of them audition anonymously.

videos.title: Connecting Melodies
videos.overview: The final competition for the third-years is at hand. The Kitauji High School Concert Band performs together one last time in a bid for National gold.
